maddeler.e:
تنافست (form VI)
# تَنَافَسْتُ (tanāfastu) /ta.naː.fas.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَافَسَ (tanāfasa)
# تَنَافَسْتَ (tanāfasta) /ta.naː.fas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَافَسَ (tanāfasa)
# تَنَافَسْتِ (tanāfasti) /ta.naː.fas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَافَسَ (tanāfasa)
# تَنَافَسَتْ (tanāfasat) /ta.naː.fa.sat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
